scenarioConfig.description: BASE CASE. Z+ protected movement from Gandhinagar into the city core on a Monday mid-morning: down the Gandhinagar-Ahmedabad Highway (1026-1025-1024) through Koba and Bhat Circles, over the Indira Bridge (1048), along Airport Road (1028-1027) to Shahibaug and in on Dr. Ambedkar Road (1043) to Lal Darwaja. scenarioConfig.description: 148th Ahmedabad Rath Yatra (27 Jun 2025): three chariots step off at 07:00 from the ~400-year-old Jamalpur temple and crawl the old-city bazaar belt of India's second-largest Rath Yatra (~14 km in all). Modeled on the walled city's real streets: east along one-way Gandhi Road to Kalupur (1012), south past Sarangpur Darwaja (1049) and west along one-way Swami Vivekananda Road toward Jamalpur (1013), with Relief Road (1005) shut alongside. Modeled as an X-class managed movement (the procession itself, not a protected person) at chariot pace (8 km/h, the engine floor) with full street closure rolling ahead of it and lakhs-strong crowd load on every segment.

chariot crawl on Relief Road — old-city bazaar belt closed
Swami Vivekananda Road bazaar crowd pinned behind barricades

scenarioConfig.description: FLAGSHIP multi-event showcase. 09:20 on the real 148th Rath Yatra morning of 27 Jun 2025 (procession stepped off 07:00 from Jamalpur): three chariots crawl Gandhi Road and Relief Road with lakhs on the street, a monsoon burst at 18 mm/h waterlogs the Nehru Bridge approach, bazaar crowds stand behind Swami Vivekananda Road barricades — and a 108 ambulance carrying a cardiac patient requests a green corridor across the river: Relief Road -> Nehru Bridge -> Ashram Road south -> Riverfront West (1005->1015->1001->1006). The engine's answer: closure_policy = signal_hold at 45 s advance — 'regulated, not stopped' — threading a medical convoy between a public festival and the weather.

unit_tracks.note: Recorded agency-unit positions the City Command REPLAY animates (agency_unit frames, a frame every 20 s of tape time). EMULATED units only (EM ids): two Jan Rakshak beats on the yatra roads (Gandhi Road + Relief Road) and the 108 ambulance's green-corridor run, Relief Road -> Nehru Bridge across the river to Income Tax Circle (J2), timed to the emergency_vehicle windows (1005 from 600 s, 1015 from 700 s); the 1006 / 1001 windows hold the cross traffic at J2 as it clears. Its last frame, at J2, is stationary and reports 'arrived' (the C-A spelling of on_scene): the green corridor ends there, and the hospital leg beyond J2 is not recorded. Geometry: the run's segment paths from the store (COALESCE(display_geom, geom)) when it has them, else route_geometry — the same segments as seeded (sample_corridor.sql).

scenarioConfig.description: A Kumbh-class bathing-day window (the Maha Kumbh 2025 class: ~660 million visits over the mela, largest gathering on earth). The corridor problem inverts: the zone interior is car-free and frozen; what the engine manages is the perimeter ring and the ingress surges. Modeled on the corridor network's riverfront cluster — Ashram Road south (1001) onto Riverfront West (1006) and up Ashram Road through Usmanpura (1009) — with an X-class supply/medical shuttle entering the zone at 04:30 pre-dawn under signal_hold (signals keep cycling: staged ingress, not blanket freeze).

east-bank queueing corridors at capacity
Ashram Road approach saturated by pilgrim arrivals

scenarioConfig.description: The most predictable corridor event: months-long lane loss published in advance. Ahmedabad Metro Phase 2 (Motera to Gandhinagar's Mahatma Mandir, built since Feb 2021; 77.63 km network approved) put Kankaria Road under a published 3 Jul - 30 Sep closure with diversions, and ~100 m at Kalupur Bridge shut for bullet-train pillar work. Kalupur Bridge bullet-train pillar works — standing lane loss on Station Road
diverted bazaar traffic squeezing Kankaria Road

scenarioConfig.description: EMULATED WATCHLIST SCENARIO (clearly labelled, never a live feed). A stolen-vehicle FIR drives an ANPR camera sweep around the walled city: over Nehru Bridge (1015) to Lal Darwaja, east along one-way Gandhi Road (1012) to Kalupur, south past Sarangpur Darwaja (1049) and west along one-way Swami Vivekananda Road (1013). Deterministic camera reads cover background traffic, the FIR-named STOLEN plate GJ27EM9001 and the earmark-exercise plate GJ27EM4321 — every synthetic plate carries an EM segment, every sighting lands with source emulated_anpr, and the oracle, never the tape, computes each hit and rule. The FIR is the scenario's premise, stated at t0 as a labelled EMULATED precondition (a stolen_vehicle_fir earmark on GJ27EM9001 by 'event-emulator (system) — scenario precondition'; if the oracle cannot take it, that plate's reads are skipped): the stolen car's reads hit as stolen_vehicle and file evidence-only R_STOLEN_SIGHTING recommendations, never a fine. GJ27EM4321 is an OPERATOR EXERCISE: the emulator never earmarks it, so its reads hit as earmarked_plate only when a duty officer has earmarked GJ27EM4321 (Watchlist: a lawful basis and their name) before the run — on a fresh install they are ordinary sightings. Only a named human officer acts on any recommendation. Two Jan Rakshak patrol units animate alongside (agency_unit frames). Vehicles only, never persons.
scenarioConfig.name: Stolen-Vehicle ANPR Sweep — Old-City Belt (Emulated)
